verdict.rationale: The evidence only implies an account-free paper path. USCIS contrasts online filing with paper filing (uscis-docs-7) and tells mail filers to complete paper Forms G-1450/G-1650 (uscis-docs-12), which suggests the forms are publicly available. Account requirements appear only for online filing (uscis-supp-3), but no item explicitly says form PDFs and their instructions can be downloaded from the site without logging in. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of account-free form and instruction downloads (e.g., a forms page with downloadable PDFs and instructions), hands-on or independent corroboration of account-free access.
